Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: coherent whole-figure pixel-art WALK animation for a native 64x64 square-grid roguelike.
Input 1 is the exact APPEARANCE / PROPORTIONS master. Input 2 is a different cultist used ONLY as approved MOVEMENT / PROJECTION guide. Copy neither the movement guide's outfit nor anatomy.
Character: The EXACT hunched possessed humanoid in image 1: muscular pale dirty flesh, small lowered bald head tucked into its hunched shoulders and leaning toward the same anatomical side, scarred bare torso, extremely long hanging arms with large dark reddish clawed hands, dark green-grey ragged trousers and heavy dark boots. No weapon, no horns or wings. Preserve its short stooped silhouette rather than turning it into a tall upright zombie. Exactly two arms and two legs, claws remain attached to hands; entire head visible within each cell.
Task: redraw only its locomotion while retaining the master's identity, build, proportions, accessories, materials and light level.
Direction: true FRONT view walking south/down TOWARD viewer, same slightly elevated game projection, all first eight cells.
Sheet: exactly THREE columns by THREE rows of equal cells, row-major order. First eight cells are eight distinct full-body poses; ninth is relaxed front idle. Transparent alpha-zero background including all spaces between limbs; absolutely no floor, shadow, grey/white matte, checkerboard, grid, lettering or labels. Leave generous empty margins around every COMPLETE figure, all heads, horns, axe, claws and feet inside their cells. Identical scale and body proportions in all cells.
Cycle: 1 left foot reaches to contact, right trails; 2 body settles onto planted left foot; 3 right foot passes close underneath hip, low knee; 4 right foot reaches for next contact; 5 opposite right contact; 6 settles onto planted right; 7 left foot passes underneath hip; 8 left reaches to repeat pose1. Two alternating steps, 400 ms per step, 800ms per complete cycle. Eight DISTINCT leg phases, not duplicated poses.
Use the movement guide's quiet, readable foot plants and compact forward/backward stride. Preserve this creature's actual posture, bent knees and weight. Feet do NOT splay sideways, no high marching knees or dance, no wide scissor stance or toes dragging. Head stays firmly attached to torso, slight coherent shoulder balance, minimal bounce. Whole connected figure, no translated strips, detached joints or grafted body pieces. Empty hands remain attached, with modest natural counterbalance.
Style: EXACT dark hand-painted PIXEL ART of appearance master, clean small pixel clusters and dark readable silhouettes at native 56–91px figure height. No smooth HD illustration, blur, airbrush, realistic grain, extra glow, or brighter highlights. Preserve the original apparent camera angle and compact game scale.
